attributes.subdivision: Structures (excluding prefabricated buildings of heading 9406) and parts of structures (for example, bridges and bridge-sections, lock-gates, towers, lattice masts, roofs, roofing frameworks, doors and windows and their frames and thresholds for doors, shutters, balustrades, pillars and columns), of iron or steel; plates, rods, angles, shapes, sections, tubes and the like, prepared for use in structures, of iron or steel

attributes.rule: Manufacture from materials of any heading, except that of the product. However, welded angles, shapes and sections of [heading 7301](/headings/7301) may not be used.
rule_class: CTH RESTRICTION MAY NOT BE USED
